desc: Derive cost function: for fixed block path, min stairs = |Y-Z| + 2*max(0, min(Y,Z) - min F along path) via TV-minimization with upper bounds (verified on both sample queries: 10 and 2).
Reduce to widest-path (maximin) problem: answer depends on M = max over paths of min edge weight, computed via maximum spanning tree path minimum.
Implement the solution: Kruskal max-ST on grid (≤500k edges), binary lifting for path-min queries, fast I/O, formula per query; complexity O(HW log(HW) + Q log(HW)).
Verify edge cases: same block (M=∞ → answer |Y-Z|), grid always connected, large F up to 1e6 fits in int, sample outputs 10 and 2 confirmed, binary lifting correctness checked.
